output.question: What is Accenture's annual revenue?
output.answer: Accenture's most recent annual revenue is $74.18 billion, for fiscal 2026, the year that ended August 31, 2026. That was up 6% in U.S. dollars and 5% in local currency from about $69.67 billion in fiscal 2025, an increase of about $4.5 billion. Fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue was $18.7 billion, up 6% in U.S. dollars and 7% in local currency. Accenture reported these results on October 1, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Fiscal 2026 revenues were $74.18 billion, up 6% in USD and 5% in local currency.
Revenue rose by $4.5 billion from fiscal 2025, when it was about $69.67 billion.
Q4 FY2026 revenues were $18.7 billion, up 6% in USD and 7% in local currency.
Accenture's fiscal year 2026 ended August 31, 2026, and results were released on October 1, 2026.

passages.quote: Revenues for fiscal 2026 were $74.18 billion, an increase of 6% in U.S. dollars and 5% in local currency
Revenues of $18.7 billion for the quarter, an increase of 6% in U.S. dollars and 7% in local currency
$74.2 billion for the year, an increase of $4.5 billion or 6% in U.S. dollars and 5% in local currency

caveats: Accenture's fiscal year runs from September 1 to August 31, so 'annual revenue' here means FY2026 (Sept 2025 to Aug 2026), not the calendar year.
Some places round the figure to $74.2 billion instead of $74.18 billion. Both describe the same reported number.
The fiscal 2025 comparison figure (~$69.67B) comes from a summary of the income statement on the 8-K exhibit page.

The next annual figure (FY2027) won't be reported until around late September 2027. The company guided to 3–6% local-currency revenue growth for FY2027, a figure that appeared only in search snippets and was not checked on an opened page.
